sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
equipment inspection checklist I2 , which must be performed on monthly bases as 
indicated by M1 in the title block .

The generator data: 277MVA, 
15.75KV, 10.173KA, PF=0.8, 50HZ, 3000 rpm Y connection

The first draft initiated by eng. 
Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, tested by eng. Enas Azmy, revised by EDEPC quality 
control eng. Saad Bassuony, accepted by eng. Aly Abdel Wahab general director 
and approved by eng. Fathy Ragab head sector of Talkha PS

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil: EDEPC inspection & quality 
 control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant 
 Mahmoud Soliman EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general 
 director and supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.

السلامة 
الاحتياطات

A work permit must be issued, 
 the maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding work area is required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment.
يجب أن تكون الوحدة في الخدمة.

items: Safety helmet, safety shoes, breathing mask, safety glass etc

sections.text: العمل الذي يتعين القيام به

Inspect 
 the brush vibration.

Inspect 
 the sparking brushes.

Inspect 
 brush holders and slip rings.
Replace the brush by new one if its height falls to 25mm.

Record 
 current and voltage value of generator as in table (1) and compare the results 
 with the standard value.

Measure 
 the current in each brush and record it in table (2) if the current in any 
 brush less than 10A, according to the recommendation from specialist, replace 
 it.

Measure the leakage AC voltage between bearings of generator as in figure 1 
 approximately ≥ 2Vac
